    • setAllowRemoteLinks

      public void setAllowRemoteLinks(boolean allowRemoteLinks)
      Enables or disables automatic resolution of linked tables that point to a network/UNC path.

      Disabled by default; see the security note on Metadata.Property.allowRemoteLinks for why this matters when opening database files from an untrusted source.

      Parameters:
      allowRemoteLinks - true to allow automatic resolution of network/UNC linked paths
